reviews.x: I ordered these thermal spa heated mittens for my husband who has RA.  He loves them.  He doesn't use the plastic liners so I made some out of fleece so he could leave his hands in longer.  He said it made his hands feel better for a while which is worth every penny. Ordering couldn't have been easier and received in a very timely manner.

No one product provides pain relief for my RA. This is one tool I use.  This product works great with my compression gloves since it does not come with covers. I let the mitts warm up with my hands inside.  After awhile, it does feel like the mitts are cooling off but that is due to my hands absorbing the heat. I simply remove my hands and flatten out the mitts for a minute to build up the heat then reinsert my hands. If left empty too long, the mitts become very hot so use caution.  It did not

This is the greatest thing for achy hands. I'm a knitter so I use these about everyday. I put lotion on before using and the heat just makes the hands look better. The only problem is they are a little bulky but worth the money.

They  work just like it says. My boyfriend has arthritis in his hands, he puts any lotion on, put his hands in the plastic bags then have the  preheated gloves then slip hands into gloves for 15 min. it's very relaxing also.  It also make my hand very smooth and soft. I bought them for him!! Oh, it also make his hands quit hurting.
These mitts are cumbersome and provide limited flexibility due to their design and size.  Also, they heat very quickly and the user should be careful to avoid burns.

If there were more than 5 stars I would have given it that rating.  These are wonderful for anyone who has arthritis, carpel tunnel and/or any other pain issues with their hands.  This is the best purchase I have made to help with my hand pain.  Also very good for conditioning dry cracked hands.  Apply lotion and insert hands.  High recommended.

I bought two pair of these warmers. One quit working after a day. The other held out for 30 days and then quit.  One expects a few defective products occasionally, but 2 out of 2 is a trend. These products are definitely defective and should not be purchased!

reviews.t: Just received mitts but they cannot be used
reviews.x: 1) "Convenient washable liner included" is stated in the seller's item description, on the packaging, and is listed in the safety instructions as a requirement for use, yet no type of liner was included with the product. 2) Seller's description and packaging description states mitts have three heat settings, but the only options are "0" for OFF, and "1" and "2" for what must be low and high. 3) The odor of the plastic is overwhelming, similar to that of a cheap be

I purchased these to use with a Parrafin Wax Hand Tank - they greatly enhance the hand-spa experience.  I've had occasion to use them by themselves, but prefer to use along with the Hand Wax Spa treatment
Only 2 settings, unless your consider OFF as one setting - then you have 3. Two mitts but only ONE liner is provided. I find that odd.

I ordered this for the joint pain I have in my hands due to RA, especially during the cold months in the Northeast. On receipt, I made fleece mitts to go inside the plastic heating mitts for comfort. This helped some, but I found myself nonplussed by the design (bulky and awkward) and function (none. You can't do anything while wearing these). I ended up finding a "muff" style fleece warmer on clearance at Walmart for $2.50 and took the partial refund I could get on these. They are just

I purchased this product for my mom who suffers from 'cold hands' all the time. What I really like about this item is how warm the product gets. What I didn't like was that there weren't covers for it (like a heating pad). I made them myself. The plastic edges are very scratchy and would probably cut my mother's paper thin skin. I made the covers out of fleece (lined inside and out) and they're very nice now... :-)
I bought these for my Mom who has arthritis in her hands and the warming mitts seem to help.  The mitts are more convenient than just a plain heating pad.
Love the product. I have pretty bad arthritis in my thumbs. I put socks on my hands and plug these  babies in. It helps a lot.

reviews.t: Not worth the money, crack and fall apart after five months.
reviews.x: Have had these mitts for 18 months.  The material they are made of is very hard and inflexible. They cracked in several places after only using them daily for five months. I have Raynauds syndrome, as a result my hands are in constant pain with sores at the tips of my fingertips.  Every time my fingers bumped into the hard interior of the mitts it was quite painful. After owning for 18 months they were so cracked I could no longer use them. I strongly recommend NOT buying these mittens if you ha

I really liked these and used them a few times for my arthritis, (I bought the little cotton gloves you can buy to put on over lotion to use instead of the plastic). But then when my pain got bad again and tried to use them they wouldn't work and it was after the 90 days warranty.... too bad for me

These are much easier to use than a paraffin bath and warm up quickly.  They are for a 95 year old woman who lives in an assisted living home.  She feels the heat helps her hands especially during stormy weather.

reviews.t: Do not waste your money in this product
reviews.x: They are not what I was expected, need to be more delicate and need more direction since you need a cream that nobody mention

I bought these mitts for my wife who suffers from arthritis.  She placed her hands in the mitts with both resting in her lap one on top of the other.  Soon she smelled hot plastic and was shocked to fine that the mitts had melted together.  They were promptly unplugged and discarded. Fortunately she suffered no injury. Sale of this product should be discontinued before someone is injured.

reviews.t: Hand warmer for elderly who have circulation problems
reviews.x: I bought this as a Christmas present for my father-in-law who lives in a nursing home and can't seem to get his hands warm enough.  He was very excited to receive it, but I don't know any more than that.  I was just glad that there is such a product as a hand warmer for people who have poor circulation (like my father-in-law) who can really use a way to get his hands warm.

Really liked this  the first time I used it. I am elderly with arthritic hands and was so glad to find something like this. However, much to my shock, went to use it again and the units had overheated and fused together. Was plugged in but not turned on. I  must  acknowledge, that the company did promptly refund the purchase price when I wrote Amazon about it.

Only warning is that they can get rather warm, but I use them with paraffin was and the plastic liners, so the heat is not a problem. Mitts are warm within about 10 minutes of powering them on. I use these every time I use the paraffin was and receive excellent results. Mitts arrived brand new in box and super fast shipping!
These are plastic inside and get too hot.  I bought these for my elderly father with arthritis.  He accidentally hit the on switch when he was not using them and they melted together on the inside.
I found the mittens really god for healing my aching hands!  While they are excellent, they also get really hot after a awhile! Take care!

Used it twice and it really helped relieve the pain of my RA. However there was no washable lining included as stated on ad. So i just used cheap gloves from walmart and it was fine to protect my hands from burning. When I was preparing to use it  a third time, I turned it on waiting to heat up and the plastic melted together. So unfortunately, i had to return it but will buy another. Overall i love the size, bc I have petite hands, it covers half my arm helping with the painful RA in my wrists.

claims.text: Many reviewers with arthritis or hand pain report the mitts provide relief and help their hands feel better.
Several reviewers find the mitts bulky, awkward, or inflexible.
Some reviewers note the mitts lack covers or liners, with only one liner provided for two mitts, prompting users to make their own.
A few reviewers report durability problems, including defective units that stopped working or cracked and fell apart.
Some reviewers mention the mitts heat quickly and caution about burns or cooling off over time.
